children: Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust declared October distributions of $0.0557 gross per share across its listed common stock classes.
Net distributions range from $0.0451 to $0.0557 per share after applicable stockholder servicing fees.
Distributions are payable to holders of record after the close of business on October 31, 2026, with payment expected around November 20.
Payments will be made in cash or reinvested for participants in the distribution reinvestment plan.
Class C has no distribution amount presented because it is generally an accumulating share class.
